review.decision: Exercise the v1 DSH receiver from the release against the candidate Go writer in a private shared spool.
review.notes: The isolated prototype first established that both paths are reachable. This review records the observed boundary and design for the final catalogue. It does not claim independent approval, installed-agent verification, or capacity enforcement by older Go writers. Capacity fixture re-review: derive the nearly full queue from the production active slots and reservation. Retain existing refusal, settlement, replay, corruption and cancellation assertions.

cases.description: A v1 receiver and current Go writer finish in the same bounded input spool.
cases.setup: Private HOME with the shipped DSH module, addressed synthetic pending request, and near-capacity unrelated entries.
cases.action: Pause the actual DSH receiver after it claims but before it writes a receipt. Retry its ID, admit one Go request and reject another. Finish the Go request, release the v1 receiver, and repeat the addressed legacy invocation.
cases.expected: The unconfirmed claim prevents replay. The admissible Go request and the existing DSH request both settle; the over-capacity request is refused. Repeated legacy receive and Go retry reuse one accepted receipt and do not deliver the message again.
